title: Swing Arm Towel Rail, Double Arm, 12.5-Inch, Solid Brass | Satin Chrome | Assorted Wall Accessories | Allied Brass
body_html:
Need more towel space without cluttering the wall? This double swing arm towel rail gives you two pivoting arms that swing out for use and fold in close to the wall when you’re done in Satin Chrome, which provides a brushed, matte-like surface that resists fingerprints while maintaining a modern, understated elegance.

  • Satin Chrome coordinates seamlessly with chrome faucets and fixtures
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Maintain a clean, finished installation with concealed screw mounting hardware
  • Choose a coordinated look as part of the Assorted Wall Accessories collection with multiple designer finish options available
  • Built for lasting use with solid brass construction

Specs & Installation

  • Product dimensions (L x H x W): 12.5 x 7.1 x 7 inches
  • Box dimensions (L x H x W): 18 x 12 x 12 inches
  • Shipping weight: 7 lbs
  • Mounting: wall-mounted with concealed screw mounting hardware
  • Style: transitional
